The current 1d+2c→4dc, 4dc→5, and 5→pheromone 6 arrows were separated. The cited five-step 2c→6 route is literature_example. The current comparison route 1g+2c→4gc and two-stage 4gc→4dc conversion were retained separately with every displayed reagent/equivalent and product-specific yield/ee.
